advisory: Deep metadata embedded in the file by the capturing device/software, for technical reviewers. GPS is reduced to a presence flag; raw coordinates are never included. Does not duplicate the manifest's mime/size/hash facts.

parts.fieldsOmittedReason: Fields not listed in fieldsPresent were absent from the file's embedded metadata (common for downloaded/exported/screenshotted/stripped files). Absent fields are omitted (never null). Raw GPS coordinates are intentionally never included.
